clips.title: The story
paras: Pozzik of the goblin racing team is waiting on a prototype fuel regulator that Gazlowe promised a few weeks ago, and it has not come. Gazlowe is usually very prompt, so Pozzik asks you to go to Ratchet and ask what happened, since the gnomes are gaining on the team.

Pozzik calls the racing team the pride of goblins, and says many people help it in one way or another. Gazlowe hunts down parts from all over the world for the team, and once even came to work on one of their rigs. A few weeks ago Gazlowe said a new prototype fuel regulator would be sent, but nothing has arrived, which is unlike him. With the gnomes gaining, Pozzik asks you to go to Ratchet and ask Gazlowe about it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our racing team is the pride of goblins everywhere. You'd be surprised at some of the people who contribute in one way or another to our team.
You know Gazlowe? He tracks down parts from around the world for us. He even came down to work on one of our rigs once!

A few weeks ago, he said he'd send us a new prototype fuel regulator but it hasn't come yet. He's usually very prompt... Maybe you wouldn't mind going to Ratchet to ask him about it? I wouldn't be so pushy, but the gnomes are gaining on us!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Pozzik sent you, huh? You know, Pozzik was one of the most respected tinkerers in Undermine before he retired to start working on the racers.

The first thing he did when he joined the team was develop the two engine model racers. Could be that the businesses will suffer without him working with the Tinkers' Union, but who cares, right? There's nothing like the races!
